trendSummary: Search interest is rising most strongly for winter camping (+41% YoY, 14.7% three-month slope, breakout query "heated tent camping"), bikepacking (+54% YoY), wildlife safari (+37% YoY, breakout "small group safari") and backpacking trips (+35% YoY). Ski passes are the clear decliner (-3% YoY, negative slope), while kayak tours are flat YoY (+5%) despite a strong 16.4% three-month slope and a 110% rising query for Baja sea kayaking. For the Nov 2026 to Jan 2027 plan window, winter-indexed interests (snow sports at 1.55, camping at 1.09) carry the most seasonal weight, while cycling (0.48) and water sports (0.43) are seasonally weak.
customerSummary: Premium Adventurers have the highest engagement (8.9% mean click rate) and value (mean LTV $7,329), with strong affinity for wildlife safari (61.5%) and snow sports and eco lodges (53.8% each). Deal Seekers and Mindful Explorers show the strongest hiking affinity (73.1% each), and Family Getaways over-index on camping (58.1%) and water sports (61.3%). Lapsed Wanderers have a 1.6% click rate with 19 of 31 eligible members dormant, so any reactivation should be low-volume and well targeted. Three members per segment are suppressed for sensitive life events and are excluded from all targeting.

insights.title: Winter camping is the fastest-rising winter-timed interest
insights.summary: Observed: winter camping search interest is up 41% YoY with a 14.7% three-month slope, peaks in December, and has a plan-window seasonality index of 1.66. Interpreted: this timing fits the plan window well, and the Family Getaways segment's 58.1% camping affinity makes it the most natural audience.
insights.label: observed

insights.title: Bikepacking is surging but seasonally weak in the plan window
insights.summary: Observed: bikepacking is up 54% YoY with a breakout rising query for gravel bike tours, but its plan-window seasonality index is only 0.48 and its peak month is July. Interpreted: demand is growing, but the window is a poor time to push cycling trips, so consider nurturing now and selling closer to spring.
insights.label: interpreted

insights.title: Premium Adventurers over-index on safari, snow and eco lodges
insights.summary: Observed: Premium Adventurers show 61.5% wildlife safari affinity and 53.8% for both snow sports and eco lodges, with an 8.9% click rate, the highest of any segment. Wildlife safari is up 37% YoY with a breakout 'small group safari' query, and its plan-window index is 0.93. Interpreted: a small-group safari offer is the strongest premium lead, with snowshoe and eco-lodge packages as the next tier.
insights.label: observed

insights.title: Snow sports timing is strong but generic ski demand is declining
insights.summary: Observed: ski passes are down 3% YoY with a negative slope, while snowshoe tours are up 27% YoY with a breakout 'snowshoe lodge package' query. Snow sports has the highest plan-window seasonality index (1.55). Interpreted: lead with guided snowshoe and lodge packages rather than generic ski passes, which are losing ground.
insights.label: interpreted

insights.title: Hiking affinity is concentrated in value-driven segments
insights.summary: Observed: Deal Seekers and Mindful Explorers both show 73.1% hiking affinity, while hiking search interest is up 22% YoY (backpacking trips +35%, with a breakout query for Patagonia backpacking). Hiking's plan-window index is 0.63 and Family Getaways affinity is only 9.7%. Interpreted: hiking offers reach value-led audiences well, but expect seasonal softness in the window.
insights.label: observed

insights.title: Family water sports interest is strong in affinity but weak seasonally
insights.summary: Observed: Family Getaways show 61.3% water sports affinity, and kayak tours are flat YoY (+5%) but have a 16.4% three-month slope and a 110% rising query for Baja kayaking. The water sports plan-window index is 0.43, the lowest of any interest. Interpreted: the Baja Sea Kayak launch on 2027-01-20 is the main timing lever, so build awareness before the launch.
insights.label: interpreted

insights.title: Multigenerational and family winter getaways are a rising query set
insights.summary: Observed: family adventure trips are up 17% YoY, with a 105% rising query for multigenerational vacations and an 80% rise for family winter getaways. Family Getaways show 51.6% affinity for family adventure, and the Yellowstone Winter Family Week launches on 2026-12-07 within the plan window. Its plan-window index is 0.92.
insights.label: observed

insights.title: Lapsed Wanderers respond weakly, so keep reactivation light
insights.summary: Observed: Lapsed Wanderers have a 1.6% mean click rate, 19 of 31 eligible members are dormant, and the fatigue cap is one send per week. Their best-affinity interests (wildlife safari and eco lodges, both 45.2%) match rising trends. Interpreted: use low-frequency, high-relevance reactivation with safari and eco-lodge content instead of broad campaigns.
